nameOrigin: a mineral in its natural state

pokedexEntries.bk: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

pokedexEntries.wh: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: When it is healthy, its core sticks out. Always facing the same way, it swiftly moves front to back and left to right.

pokedexEntries.x: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

pokedexEntries.or: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

pokedexEntries.y: When it is healthy, its core sticks out. Always facing the same way, it swiftly moves front to back and left to right.

pokedexEntries.as: When it is healthy, its core sticks out. Always facing the same way, it swiftly moves front to back and left to right.

pokedexEntries.su: Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.

pokedexEntries.mo: It explores caves in search of underground water. It’s not comfortable around water, so this Pokémon takes great care in lapping it up.

pokedexEntries.us: The energy overflowing from its body has turned into orange crystals that are hard enough to smash diamonds.

pokedexEntries.um: Its orange crystals are lumps of powerful energy. They’re valuable, so Boldore is sometimes targeted for them.

pokedexEntries.sw: If you see its orange crystals start to glow, be wary. It’s about to fire off bursts of energy.

pokedexEntries.sh: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.
